M01.scenario: You are the chief information officer at a large teaching hospital in Riyadh. The IT security team has discovered a vulnerability in the electronic health records system that could potentially expose patient data. A fix is being prepared and will be implemented within the next 48 hours. Write a clear and reassuring briefing for the senior medical leadership, who have limited technical expertise, that explains the situation, its impact, and the actions you will take.
M01.instructions: Which approach should you take to inform the management team about the ConnectApp slowness bug, so they are reassured and understand the 48-hour fix without unnecessary alarm?
choices: Brief senior medical leaders in plain language: explain the minor performance issue on older mobile hardware, confirm patient data safety, state that a tested patch will deploy within 48 hours, and outline interim safeguards.
Provide an extensive technical root-cause breakdown including stack traces and memory profiles, requesting that senior medical leadership determine the technical remediation path.
Issue an immediate emergency system alert to all hospital departments advising staff of system instability, while holding executive briefings until post-patch verification.
Summarize the patch schedule and deployment timeline accurately to executive leadership, but omit specific operational workarounds and temporary user guidance.

M02.scenario: As the head of the Student Retention Office at King Saud University, you have been tasked with addressing a 15% surge in first-year student attrition during the current academic year. The university’s leadership has received numerous complaints from students about delayed academic advising appointments, insufficient information on course prerequisites, and limited access to tutoring services. Preliminary data shows that average advising wait time has risen from 3 days to 9 days, while the number of students missing key course milestones increased by 12%. The upcoming semester will begin in two weeks, creating operational pressure to implement immediate corrective actions while ensuring long-term sustainability. Your mission is to lead a cross-functional team to apply the Six Sigma DMAIC process and construct an Ishikawa diagram to pinpoint underlying causes, evaluate data-driven solutions, and design a monitoring system that will track the effectiveness of the interventions.
M02.instructions: Which problem-solving approach should you lead to diagnose and fix the 25% increase in average delivery time for UrbanEat?
choices: Run DMAIC: Define problem and wait-time baselines, Measure order handoff and courier routing metrics, Analyze root causes via Ishikawa diagram, Improve top bottlenecks, and Control with KPI dashboards.
Measure current delivery times and order volumes, then immediately implement a revised courier routing protocol before completing a root-cause analysis.
Convene an operational alignment task force to improve courier communication and dispatch tools, focusing on team coordination without analyzing baseline latency metrics.
Apply DMAIC by defining the issue and analyzing historical courier performance, but focus remediation solely on third-party vendor SLAs while leaving internal app dispatch unaddressed.

M03.scenario: You are a senior engineer at a renewable energy startup developing an IoT grid management system. The lead hardware engineer has identified that the newly proposed sensor firmware update would exceed the power budget of the devices already deployed in the field, recommending a complete redesign of the firmware before the planned rollout next month. The project manager, under pressure to meet a government grant deadline, argues that a temporary work‑around should be implemented to keep the release on schedule, even though it may not fully resolve the power issue. Your organization uses the Thomas‑Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument as its conflict‑resolution framework, and you have been asked to facilitate a resolution as the team becomes divided and discussions turn heated.
M03.instructions: Which approach should you take to resolve the deployment conflict between the project manager and Chloe before Tuesday?
choices: Facilitate a collaborating session: surface both technical deployment risks and grant deadline constraints, negotiate a staged rollout with rollback safeguards, and commit to a joint timeline.
Apply a compromising approach by agreeing to release on schedule while reducing the firmware feature set, without resolving the underlying power budget verification.
Apply an accommodating approach by agreeing to the hardware engineer's complete redesign request, accepting the grant deadline slip without evaluating interim mitigations.
Escalate the dispute to project leadership to arbitrate between the schedule and technical requirements, providing individual assessments rather than leading joint team resolution.

M04.scenario: You are leading the development of an integrated e‑learning solution for a consortium of Saudi universities, scheduled to go live at the start of the next academic term. Two weeks before the launch, the Ministry of Education issues an urgent directive that all courses must migrate to a newly mandated Learning Management System that uses a completely different technology stack and data architecture. Your current platform cannot be delayed, and the university partners expect uninterrupted access for their students. Outline the actions you would take to respond to this abrupt scope change, assess the impact on the project timeline and resources, communicate transparently with internal and external stakeholders, and devise a pragmatic plan to transition the system while maintaining confidence and morale.
M04.instructions: Which strategy should you adopt to keep the launch on track after the breaking platform/API change with only 7 days to go?
choices: Assess feature dependencies against the mandated directive, identify compatible integration paths, reprioritize remaining scope for the 14-day window, and brief stakeholders on revised milestones and residual risk.
Conduct an immediate technical impact analysis and update stakeholders on required changes, but attempt to implement the full original scope alongside the mandatory directive without reprioritizing.
Pause current platform expansion and focus team efforts entirely on building the mandated integration, postponing stakeholder communication until migration feasibility is proven.
Implement the mandated integration for high-priority user flows while leaving secondary flows on the existing architecture, without establishing formal stakeholder approval for the dual-run strategy.

M05.scenario: You are a site supervisor for a major infrastructure project in Riyadh. During a safety briefing, you notice that the foreman, Jamal, has a tense posture, avoids eye contact, and his voice cracks when a minor safety lapse is mentioned. He also failed to submit the daily equipment inspection log, which is unusual for him. After the briefing, you have a private one‑on‑one meeting scheduled to discuss his performance and wellbeing.
M05.instructions: Which approach should you take in the one-on-one with Sara after noticing the change in her behaviour and missed deadlines?
choices: In a private 1:1, open with specific observed cues, ask open-ended questions regarding workload and wellbeing without judgment, listen actively, and agree on tailored support plus a follow-up check-in.
Focus the 1:1 on reviewing recent missed deliverables and establishing a structured performance improvement plan, offering support if workload issues are raised by the employee.
Express personal concern for the employee's wellbeing and adjust immediate task assignments, but avoid discussing the specific performance gaps to prevent added stress.
Discuss observed stress cues and offer workload adjustments during the meeting, but defer setting specific follow-up milestones or documented support commitments.

M06.scenario: You are a junior compliance officer at a Saudi-based fintech firm that provides payment gateway services to local merchants. While reconciling transaction logs for the upcoming client audit by a major bank, you notice that a batch of transactions from last week was recorded with an incorrect transaction status, indicating that a few payments were marked as settled when, in fact, they are still pending verification. This error, though limited to a small number of transactions, could lead to a breach of the bank's regulatory reporting requirements and damage the firm's reputation for reliability. The audit is scheduled to begin tomorrow morning.
M06.instructions: Which course of action should you take after discovering the outdated regulatory model in the client presentation?
choices: Verify current regulatory guidelines, discuss the outdated model privately with the senior analyst before the briefing, document required adjustments, and flag material discrepancies for immediate correction.
Prepare updated regulatory figures independently and present the revised data during the briefing, explaining the recalculation after the client Q&A session.
Present the slide using the senior analyst's figures as drafted, while preparing an addendum document with updated regulatory figures for post-meeting distribution.
Highlight the regulatory model update during the presentation as an evolving industry trend, without clarifying whether the slide data reflects the latest guidelines.

M07.scenario: In a leading Saudi aerospace manufacturing firm, the senior Vice President of Engineering, Dr. Youssef Al-Mansour, and the senior Director of Supply Chain, Aisha Al-Harbi, have become locked in a dispute over the choice of a new composite material supplier for the upcoming next‑generation jet engine program. Dr. Al-Mansour insists on a cutting‑edge supplier that promises a 15 % performance gain but carries higher cost and longer lead times, while Ms. Al-Harbi argues for a proven supplier with a reliable delivery record to meet the tight production schedule and budget constraints. Their respective teams have begun to publicly endorse the positions of their leaders, resulting in duplicated testing efforts, missed milestones, and growing tension across the organization. The Chief Operating Officer has asked you, a senior program integration manager, to step in and help resolve the disagreement without involving formal disciplinary channels, aiming to preserve the project timeline and maintain a collaborative culture.
M07.instructions: Which approach should you take to defuse the conflict between Khalid (Operations) and Layla (Product) and restore their working relationship?
choices: Hold individual meetings to understand constraints, then lead a joint session to align on shared objectives, establish a clear resource-allocation matrix, and agree on governance rules.
Propose an equal split of contested resources between both departments based on historical allocations, bypassing a detailed analysis of current project priorities.
Analyze each department's resource requirements and draft a comprehensive allocation proposal, then submit it to executive leadership for final sign-off before consulting department heads.
Facilitate a joint alignment meeting to discuss competing demands, but allow department heads to negotiate bilateral trade-offs without establishing a formal decision matrix.

M08.scenario: You are a senior quality engineer at a leading aerospace parts supplier. The company has secured a contract to deliver a batch of turbine blades to a major airline for a scheduled fleet upgrade, with a delivery deadline in two weeks. The production line is behind schedule due to unexpected material defects, and your plant manager instructs you to bypass the final non‑destructive testing verification step for a portion of the batch, arguing that the parts have already passed earlier inspections and that the client will accept them with a note for post‑delivery testing. Skipping the NDT could reduce the likelihood of detecting hidden cracks that may cause catastrophic failure in flight, but adhering to the full testing protocol would delay shipment and risk losing the contract and associated revenue.
M08.instructions: Which action should you take when your manager asks you to cut quality-control corners to meet the client deadline?
choices: Maintain essential quality control: explain delivery risks to stakeholders, propose a phased delivery of verified components, or negotiate a short window extension with documented risk mitigation.
Perform a condensed quality check on high-risk features to meet the deadline, documenting skipped test cases for post-launch verification.
Request an immediate deadline extension from the client to complete full quality assurance, without presenting a phased release option or interim risk assessment.
Complete all required quality assurance steps by reallocating team members from secondary tasks, while accepting unmitigated delays on the secondary deliverables.

M09.scenario: You are a 2025 Saudi graduate with a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, specializing in Power Systems. In the past six weeks you have been applying to posted vacancies on the HRSD portal, LinkedIn, and Jadarat, yet you have only received generic acknowledgment emails. A career advisor explains that the hidden job market accounts for a large share of hires in the Kingdom’s utilities, renewable energy, and smart grid projects, with many roles filled through referrals, alumni contacts, and sector conferences before any public posting. You have eight weeks to develop a structured job‑search strategy that integrates push‑based networking and pull‑based direct applications, selects a realistic mix of channels including online platforms, sector events, and alumni networks, and respects Saudi professional etiquette.
M09.instructions: Which four-week job-search strategy should you adopt to access the hidden job market in the Saudi context?
choices: Execute a balanced strategy: combine targeted applications on official portals (HRSD, Jadarat, LinkedIn) with professional networking, informational interviews, and tracking weekly outreach metrics.
Focus entirely on submitting a high volume of tailored applications through official job portals, deferring direct networking until initial interviews are scheduled.
Prioritize networking with industry professionals and requesting informational interviews, while submitting standard resumes on job portals without tailoring application materials.
Build an extensive list of target companies and connect with recruitment leads on professional platforms, but delay applying until personal referrals are secured for each role.

M10.scenario: You have recently graduated from a Saudi university with a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering. You are interested in the 'Solar Power Plant Maintenance Engineer' position advertised by the renewable energy firm 'Al‑Masdar Energy' in Riyadh. The posting highlights the need for hands‑on experience with photovoltaic system diagnostics, familiarity with O&M standards, a proven track record of improving plant availability, and strong Arabic and English communication skills. In your portfolio you completed a six‑month internship at a leading solar farm where you reduced downtime by fifteen percent through systematic troubleshooting, earned a certification in O&M best practices, and have been mentoring junior technicians in bilingual technical documentation, including writing maintenance manuals in both languages.
M10.instructions: Which cover-letter opening paragraph should you write for the Marketing Analyst — Digital Campaigns role at the Saudi fintech company?
choices: Structure the application using AIDA: hook with measurable accomplishments, demonstrate alignment with role requirements, highlight specialized skills, and close with a professional call to action.
Detail relevant past technical projects and academic certifications, but omit explicit connections to the target company's specific job requirements and strategic goals.
Focus on explaining your career aspirations and passion for the organization, supported by a general summary of qualifications without quantifying past achievements.
Provide a comprehensive chronological summary of all previous roles and responsibilities, but omit a concise closing statement and explicit alignment to the target position.

M11.scenario: During a high‑visibility product launch at a leading Saudi e‑commerce platform, your team experienced a sudden system outage that prevented customers from completing purchases, and you were tasked with leading the response effort to restore service, coordinate cross‑functional teams, and minimize revenue loss.
M11.instructions: Which STAR-structured answer should you give to the interview question about working under intense pressure?
choices: Apply STAR method: outline the specific Situation (checkout outage during launch), Task (lead restoration effort), individual Actions taken (triage, cross-team coordination), and measurable Result (system restored in 25 mins, revenue impact minimized).
Describe the high-pressure situation and the immediate technical actions taken to resolve the incident, but omit specific metrics regarding the final outcome and business impact.
Explain the technical architecture and root cause of the incident in detail, describing how the overall engineering group collaborated to restore service.
Focus on the successful recovery results and key lessons learned, providing only a high-level summary of the initial problem and individual intervention steps.

M12.scenario: You are a recent graduate in civil engineering from a Saudi university, eager to start a career in large-scale infrastructure projects such as highways and bridges. Your LinkedIn profile currently includes only a profile photo, your degree, and a brief mention of a summer internship at a small local contractor, lacking a compelling headline, detailed summary, specific skill endorsements, and evidence of project work. You have identified a senior infrastructure manager at the leading Saudi construction firm Saudi Binladin Group, known for guiding junior engineers, and you wish to initiate an informational conversation to learn about professional pathways and to signal your readiness for future roles. Explain the specific enhancements you would make to your LinkedIn profile to build a coherent personal brand and draft a personalized, concise outreach message that introduces you, references your relevant experience, and asks for career advice without opening with a job request.
M12.instructions: Which LinkedIn profile and cold-outreach approach should you take before contacting the senior data analyst?
choices: Optimize profile headline, summary, and skills to highlight domain expertise, showcase verified project outcomes, and send personalized, context-rich connection requests to industry peers.
Update profile experience and skills with detailed technical descriptions, but send generic connection requests without personalizing the outreach message.
Focus outreach on sending direct messages to senior hiring managers asking about job openings, before fully updating project portfolio and recommendations.
Publish frequent industry commentary and share relevant technical articles, while keeping the background experience and project summary brief.

M13.scenario: You have just received your first full‑time job offer to join a leading Saudi e‑commerce platform as a Junior Backend Developer. The offer provides a base salary of SAR 8,500 per month, a three‑month probation period, and no provisions for remote work or a professional development budget. Your market research indicates that comparable junior backend positions in Riyadh typically command salaries between SAR 9,500 and 10,500 per month and often include a training allowance or flexible work arrangements. You have a best alternative: a part‑time freelance project with a local startup that would generate SAR 5,000 per month, and you are awaiting a final interview decision from another company that could offer around SAR 9,000. While you are enthusiastic about the role, you would like to negotiate a higher salary and secure at least one of the key contractual benefits you consider essential for your professional growth.
M13.instructions: Which negotiation approach should you take for the job offer that is slightly below the market rate?
choices: Research benchmark compensation data (SAR 9.5k–10.5k), articulate your value proposition against role requirements, present a fair salary counter-offer alongside professional growth benefits, and leverage your BATNA professionally.
Request a salary at the upper end of the benchmark range based on market research, but focus negotiation exclusively on base pay without discussing performance bonuses or professional development.
Accept the initial offer as presented and request a formal performance and compensation review after six months based on agreed deliverables.
Present market benchmark data and request an increased compensation package, but defer articulating specific additional value or accomplishments that justify the higher tier.

M14.scenario: You are a final‑year business analytics student at King Saud University, participating in a multidisciplinary capstone project to build a predictive model for retail sales. As part of the iterative peer‑review process, each group member provides written feedback on the others' contributions. Your peers indicate that you frequently miss self‑set deadlines for delivering data subsets, the code you submit lacks proper comments, and your weekly progress summaries are irregular, which points to low Conscientiousness.
M14.instructions: Which response should you give to the 360-degree feedback that points to lower Conscientiousness?
choices: Listen actively without defensiveness, acknowledge specific valid points, ask clarifying questions to understand expectations, and commit to a concrete action plan with follow-up milestones.
Accept the feedback politely and agree to implement suggested changes, but refrain from asking clarifying questions or establishing explicit follow-up review dates.
Provide context and rationale for the choices made during the task before accepting the feedback, ensuring the supervisor understands background constraints.
Commit to improving performance immediately and request additional training resources, without establishing specific measurable metrics for the required adjustments.

M15.scenario: You are a junior data analyst at a Saudi healthcare research institute preparing a public health report when you discover that a portion of the dataset includes information from individuals who did not provide consent, raising potential privacy and regulatory concerns. Your immediate task is to assess the impact, report the issue to the project lead, and ensure the final report complies with ethical standards and data protection laws.
M15.instructions: Which approach should you take to handle the professional situation with your team?
choices: Gather objective facts from frontline team members, distinguish verified data from assumptions, analyze root causes using structured techniques, and execute a documented decision with clear ownership.
Implement a proven operational fix based on past experience with similar incidents, then monitor system performance to confirm if the issue is resolved.
Conduct a detailed investigation into all potential contributing factors, deferring corrective action until a comprehensive report is completed and reviewed.
Consult key stakeholders to reach consensus on the most likely cause, executing an agreed mitigation plan without conducting independent data verification.

M16.scenario: Al-Mawarid Transport, a leading Saudi logistics firm, is developing a fleet management system to optimize delivery routes for perishable goods across the Kingdom. The project must handle fluid client contracts, evolving regional traffic regulations, and frequent input from drivers and customers to refine routing algorithms. Management seeks to launch a functional pilot within four months for a key client network and then iterate the system based on real‑world performance and stakeholder feedback.
M16.instructions: Which project methodology should you choose for QuickPlate's mobile app, and which reasoning best justifies it?
choices: Adopt Scrum/Agile: plan 2-week iterations to ship an MVP in four months, validating user experience and routing features with early feedback while adapting to evolving commercial requirements.
Select a phased Waterfall approach: define comprehensive functional specifications up front, executing sequential design and development phases before conducting end-to-end user acceptance testing.
Implement a Hybrid framework: freeze core architectural requirements while utilizing iterative sprints for user interface components, deferring deployment until all features are complete.
Utilize Kanban: maintain a continuous workflow queue without fixed iteration boundaries, prioritizing user feedback cards as operational capacity allows.

M17.scenario: You have been asked to brief the senior manager of a Saudi online marketplace on a recent performance chart. The line chart displays the monthly cart abandonment rate over the past six months for two channels: mobile devices and desktop computers. Mobile abandonment increased from 65% to 73% (an 8‑point rise), while desktop abandonment decreased from 58% to 52% (a 6‑point drop). Your manager, who is not data‑literate, says: “What does this chart tell us and what should we do?”
M17.instructions: Which insight and recommendation should you present to your manager from the website traffic chart?
choices: Analyze channel data: identify that mobile checkout abandonment rose by 8% while desktop fell by 6%, isolate mobile UX friction points, and recommend targeted mobile checkout optimization.
Highlight the total increase in mobile traffic volume and recommend reallocating marketing spend to mobile acquisition campaigns, while deferring checkout optimization.
Focus analysis on the desktop conversion stability and recommend expanding desktop promotional offers, treating mobile abandonment as an industry-standard trend.
Report the conversion gap between mobile and desktop channels, proposing an immediate overhaul of both desktop and mobile landing pages without isolating checkout drop-offs.

M18.scenario: You are a senior analyst at a renewable energy consulting firm operating in Saudi Arabia. Your director has asked you to produce a concise briefing memo for the executive board outlining recent market trends and to create a client‑facing slide deck that highlights projected cost savings. The firm's policy mandates the use of its internally hosted AI platform for all work‑related content to comply with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law, which prohibits transmitting confidential or personal data to foreign servers. The internal AI tool can rapidly synthesize information but is known to occasionally generate confident yet inaccurate figures. You have access to a confidential internal report containing proprietary cost estimates that must remain within the organization.
M18.instructions: Which approach should you take to use generative AI responsibly for the client email and the confidential report?
choices: Use approved internal AI tools with sanitized data: draft content, independently verify numerical figures against primary sources, ensure proprietary data is protected, and review tone for professional alignment.
Utilize enterprise AI tools to draft the executive briefing, but rely on automated output validation without cross-checking financial calculations against source documents.
Draft the briefing manually using internal data sources, then run the text through AI tools solely for grammar and formatting refinement without verifying contextual accuracy.
Use AI tools to summarize background industry trends and generate structural outlines, while authoring all specific client recommendations independently.

M19.scenario: You are a junior accountant at Al-Majd Financial Services, a Saudi fintech firm. You receive an email from payments@fast-transfers.xyz claiming to be from the Finance Director, stating that due to an urgent system upgrade you must immediately transfer 5,000 SAR to a new vendor account to avoid service disruption.
M19.instructions: Which action should you take after receiving the urgent gift-card request from an email address claiming to be the CEO?
choices: Verify the request through official out-of-band communication: report suspicious email headers to IT Security and confirm authorization with the executive assistant via verified internal channels.
Forward the email to IT Security for analysis while replying to the sender requesting secondary confirmation before proceeding with the purchase.
Check the internal corporate directory to verify executive contact details, then pause processing until the manager reviews the request during business hours.
Contact your direct supervisor to report the unusual executive request, while holding off on security escalation pending internal clarification.

M20.scenario: A Saudi industrial equipment manufacturer, Al‑Madina Machines, operates a plant with 10 production lines. Unplanned downtime currently costs the plant SAR 500,000 per year. The company piloted IoT predictive‑maintenance sensors on two lines, spending SAR 200,000 and saving SAR 150,000 annually through a 30% downtime reduction. Management now wants to roll out the sensor system to all 10 lines, which would require a total investment of SAR 1,000,000 (double the pilot cost). The full rollout is projected to cut overall downtime costs by SAR 750,000 per year and increase production capacity to add SAR 300,000 in revenue annually. Evaluate the decision using a SWOT analysis and a simple ROI calculation (Net Annual Benefit ÷ Investment).
M20.instructions: Which recommendation should you give the owner about doubling the social media advertising budget from SAR 10,000 to SAR 20,000?
choices: Recommend a phased budget increase: evaluate current 4.5x ROI data, conduct a SWOT analysis of scaling capacity, and test a SAR 15,000 intermediate stage while monitoring acquisition CAC and conversion rates.
Approve doubling the advertising budget immediately based on strong initial returns, establishing weekly performance reporting to track revenue growth.
Recommend maintaining the current SAR 10,000 budget while reallocating internal creative resources to improve ad click-through rates before increasing ad spend.
Propose reallocating the additional SAR 10,000 to influencer partnerships and organic content channels, comparing attribution against current paid campaigns.

M21.scenario: You are an SEO specialist for a Saudi heritage tourism company that operates luxury desert camps in AlUla. The landing page for "luxury desert camp AlUla" currently appears on page 2 of the search results, receiving 800 monthly impressions but only 8 clicks (CTR 1%). The title tag, meta description, and H1 are generic, and the page lacks detailed itinerary information and internal links from related tour pages. You have been tasked with improving the page’s organic performance within the next quarter.
M21.instructions: Which SEO strategy should you implement to improve organic performance for the landing page?
choices: Perform a search intent and keyword audit: optimize title tags, meta descriptions, and header hierarchy, enrich page content with domain-specific terms, and track ranking improvements over 90 days.
Focus optimization efforts on technical site speed and mobile page loading performance, while keeping existing landing page copy and metadata unchanged.
Expand page content by publishing weekly industry articles on the domain, while retaining current title tags and meta descriptions.
Redesign landing page visual elements and call-to-action placement to boost user engagement metrics, monitoring secondary impact on organic search traffic.

M22.scenario: On 20 July, the analytics dashboard for SoukExpress, a Riyadh-based grocery delivery service, showed a one-day traffic surge of 420% in total sessions. GA4 indicated that organic search traffic jumped by 1,300%, while direct and paid traffic remained unchanged. No new campaigns were launched, and the spike coincided with a trending TikTok video featuring the brand.
M22.instructions: Which investigation approach should you take for the one-day GA4 traffic spike?
choices: Analyze GA4 traffic acquisition reports: segment data by source/medium, user geography, and landing page behavior, cross-referencing external campaign dates to identify the primary driver.
Review Google Search Console impression data for the spike date to determine if specific search queries drove the traffic surge.
Check social media channel analytics to see if recent brand mentions aligned with the high-volume traffic day.
Compare conversion rates on the spike date against monthly averages to evaluate whether the traffic surge generated qualified leads.

M23.scenario: AlNour Sports Nutrition, a Saudi-owned company, is preparing the launch of its new high-protein snack bar, "AlNour Boost", targeting health-focused millennials in the Kingdom. The product will be sold primarily through the company’s e-commerce site and selected online grocery partners. Management has allocated SAR 120,000 for a digital-only launch over the next 90 days and aims to achieve 5,000 active purchasers who make at least one repeat purchase within that period.
M23.instructions: Which 90-day digital marketing launch plan should you propose for the mobile payments app?
choices: Execute a structured 90-day roadmap: allocate budget across Awareness, Acquisition, and Retention phases, set 30-day user milestones, and measure CAC, MAU, and 30-day retention toward the 5,000 active user target.
Allocate the majority of the budget to high-impact launch campaigns in month one, transitioning to organic social media engagement for months two and three.
Implement a continuous paid acquisition campaign focused on app store downloads, evaluating user retention metrics at the conclusion of the 90-day period.
Focus marketing efforts on influencer partnerships and referral incentives during the first 60 days, deferring performance ad spend until user onboarding is streamlined.

M24.scenario: A senior procurement officer from a mid-sized Saudi automotive parts manufacturer calls your company offering industrial robot automation solutions. The officer mentions that their current assembly line processes are causing bottlenecks, and they are considering an automation upgrade within the next fiscal year. You have 12 minutes for the call.
M24.instructions: Which set of BANT questions should you ask to qualify the inbound lead?
choices: Apply BANT systematically: confirm allocated Budget range, identify Authority and decision workflow, establish core Need and technical pain points, and clarify the implementation Timeline.
Focus qualification on assessing technical Need and project Timeline, while confirming executive Authority during subsequent product demonstrations.
Clarify Budget availability and decision Authority upfront, then schedule a dedicated technical discovery session to evaluate project Needs.
Assess project Timeline and technical requirements first, providing standard pricing tiers to qualify Budget before identifying decision makers.

M25.scenario: You have just completed a discovery call with Faisal Al-Muqati, Procurement Director at Al-Mansour Construction. He showed interest in the project management platform you offer, but indicated that his team must evaluate the budget internally and asked you to call back in two weeks. Your CRM pipeline consists of Prospect, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed-Won/Lost.
M25.instructions: Which CRM actions and follow-up should you log after the discovery call with Ahmed Al-Rasheed?
choices: Log comprehensive call notes: update BANT qualification fields, record key requirements and budget parameters, schedule follow-up milestones, and advance deal stage to Qualified Opportunity.
Update deal stage to Qualified Opportunity and create a follow-up task, summarizing key discussion points in the activity log.
Log contact details and project requirements, scheduling a follow-up presentation before updating the formal opportunity pipeline stage.
Record call notes and technical constraints in the CRM, assigning account tasks to technical pre-sales for solution design.

M26.scenario: You are a senior account manager for a Riyadh-based ERP software provider. An existing Saudi retail chain is renewing its annual support and enhancement contract. The client has received a competitor’s quote that is 12% lower and is demanding a comparable price reduction, threatening to switch vendors if you cannot meet their request. Your solution has generated a documented annual efficiency gain of SAR 180,000 for the client, and your company’s policy caps any discount at 8%. Prepare to handle the client’s price objection by focusing on the value delivered, acknowledging the competitor’s offer, and outlining a realistic path to agreement.
M26.instructions: Which negotiation approach should you take for the renewal when the client asks for a 20% price reduction?
choices: Reframe value proposition: present documented ROI achievements (SAR 180k savings), offer a policy-aligned 8% multi-year discount or value-add services, and negotiate within approved commercial boundaries.
Offer a 10% discount contingent on extending contract duration to two years, highlighting delivered platform reliability and support SLAs.
Maintain existing contract pricing while offering additional user licenses and premium support services to address the client's budget constraints.
Propose a phased pricing structure that reduces upfront costs in exchange for performance-based incentives upon achieving operational milestones.

M27.scenario: On day 5 of a two‑week sprint, a renewable‑energy SaaS team is 58 % complete with the integration of a wind‑farm monitoring API and the data pipeline for real‑time alerts. The Chief Operations Officer emails the Scrum Master, requesting that a quick‑launch dashboard for solar‑panel performance be added to the current sprint because a high‑priority client demo is scheduled next week.
M27.instructions: How should you respond to the Product Owner's request to add the CEO's new feature to the current sprint?
choices: Protect sprint commitment: explain impact on agreed sprint goals, evaluate feature urgency, propose evaluating the item for the next sprint backlog, and offer a quick effort estimation.
Assess feature scope with the engineering team and swap out an equivalent low-priority backlog item to accommodate the request within the current sprint.
Accept the high-priority feature request and adjust current sprint deliverables, updating stakeholders on revised release timelines during the sprint review.
Review technical requirements with the Product Owner and agree to initiate design work in the current sprint, deferring implementation to the subsequent sprint.

M28.scenario: A regional airline’s IT team is launching a new mobile check‑in application. The project is broken into four sequential phases represented in a network diagram: Phase A (Requirements analysis) takes 3 days. Phase A must finish before Phase B (User interface design, 2 days) and Phase C (Backend integration, 4 days) can begin. Both Phase B and Phase C must be completed before Phase D (System testing, 3 days) starts.
M28.instructions: Which critical path and project duration should you identify for the activity network?
choices: Identify path A → C → D with duration 10 days as the critical path, noting that path A → B → D has 2 days of total float.
Identify path A → B → D with duration 8 days as the primary execution path, calculating total project float across secondary paths.
Calculate project completion at 10 days based on longest path duration, assigning 2 days of float to task C.
Determine critical path as A → C → D (10 days) and recommend crashing task C by 2 days to align with path A → B → D.

M29.scenario: Your organization is gearing up to deliver a state-of-the-art solar microgrid system to the Ministry of Energy for a pilot project in Riyadh, scheduled for rollout in 14 days. The critical power inverter units are supplied by a single approved vendor in the UAE, who has just been placed under a sudden government-imposed export embargo due to a diplomatic dispute, preventing any further shipments. The vendor has no inventory on hand, and there are no other inverter manufacturers on your approved supplier list. The contract stipulates a daily penalty of SAR 250,000 for any delay beyond the agreed launch date, and the Ministry has already announced the project to the public. Senior leadership expects immediate action, and the procurement team has limited authority to add new vendors without a formal risk assessment.
M29.instructions: Which crisis-management approach should you lead when your primary supplier cannot fulfil the component order due to a factory fire two weeks before launch?
choices: Activate crisis protocol: assess safety stock and alternate supplier availability, evaluate fast-track qualification options, quantify launch impacts, and brief leadership on a revised release plan.
Contact secondary suppliers to secure replacement inventory, while working with the primary vendor to estimate factory recovery timelines.
Inform leadership of potential launch delays and initiate contingency sourcing, focusing technical resources on evaluating component substitutions.
Quantify contract penalties and financial risk while negotiating priority allocation from alternative distributor stocks.

M30.scenario: A logistics company operates a fleet of delivery trucks recorded in the Vehicles table (VehicleID, Type, MaxLoad) and logs each trip in the Trips table (TripID, VehicleID, Distance, FuelUsed). The sustainability analyst needs a report that lists every vehicle, including those that have never been assigned to a trip, with total distance and average fuel consumption shown for vehicles that have trips and NULL values for those without.
M30.instructions: Which SQL JOIN type should you use to list all customers including those without orders?
choices: Use a LEFT JOIN (or LEFT OUTER JOIN) on Customers.id = Orders.customer_id to select all records from Customers and matching records from Orders.
Use an INNER JOIN on Customers.id = Orders.customer_id and handle missing orders by applying a COALESCE function in the SELECT clause.
Use a FULL OUTER JOIN to retrieve all records from both Customers and Orders tables, filtering NULL values in the WHERE clause.
Use a RIGHT JOIN by designating Orders as the primary table and applying an IS NULL check on Customer IDs.

M31.scenario: The operations team at a Saudi-based logistics firm maintains a master sheet named 'Shipments' that records each delivery with columns Shipment_Number, Origin_City, Destination_City, and Scheduled_Date. In addition, they have a separate sheet called 'Carriers' which lists Carrier_ID, Shipment_Number, Carrier_Name, and Contact_Email for every shipment that has been assigned to a carrier. Since Shipment_Number uniquely identifies a delivery in both sheets, the team requires a method to automatically add Carrier_Name to the 'Shipments' sheet for quick reference without manual updates.
M31.instructions: Which data normalization step should you execute to eliminate transitive dependencies in the database schema?
choices: Apply Third Normal Form (3NF): ensure the relation is in 2NF and remove non-key attributes that depend on other non-key attributes by creating separate entity tables.
Apply Second Normal Form (2NF): eliminate partial dependencies by ensuring all non-key attributes are fully functionally dependent on the primary key.
De-normalize the schema by combining related lookup tables, improving query read performance while managing redundancy through database triggers.
Apply Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF): ensure every determinant in the table schema is a candidate key, modifying foreign key constraints.

M32.scenario: You are a data analyst at a leading digital health platform that sells subscription-based tele-health services to corporate clients. The sales team has compiled a 30-day dataset of subscription sales, with columns for Date, Client_ID, Service_Package, Number_of_Users, Revenue, Discount_Percent, Sales_Channel (direct or partner), and Geographic_Region. The Chief Revenue Officer asks you to examine the data and provide a data-driven suggestion that could increase revenue in the upcoming quarter.
M32.instructions: Which API rate-limiting strategy should you implement to protect microservice availability during traffic spikes?
choices: Implement a Token Bucket algorithm with Redis rate limiting: enforce per-client quotas, return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After headers, and log quota breaches.
Configure Fixed Window rate limiting at the API gateway, returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable when request thresholds are exceeded within a minute.
Apply Leaky Bucket traffic shaping to smooth out inbound requests, queuing excess traffic until worker instances scale horizontally.
Implement IP-based rate throttling with dynamic blocking rules, exempting authenticated corporate users from concurrency limits.

M33.scenario: A Riyadh‑based electronics manufacturing firm, Al‑Hadeed Tech, currently employs 80 workers: 45 Saudi nationals and 35 expatriates. Its current Saudization rate of 56.3% places the company in the "Medium" Nitaqat band for its sector. The firm has received a contract that requires 12 additional expatriate technicians. HR has asked you to evaluate the compliance implications of this expansion and to propose a course of action.
M33.instructions: Which Saudization compliance assessment and course of action should you recommend for Al-Hadeed Tech under Nitaqat guidelines?
choices: Recalculate Saudization impact: adding 12 expatriates drops the ratio to 48.9% (Low Nitaqat band); recommend registering new hires on Qiwa and hiring at least 9 Saudis to maintain the Medium band.
Approve hiring the 12 expatriate technicians while establishing an internal Saudi apprenticeship program to balance workforce ratios over the next 12 months.
Recommend hiring 6 expatriate technicians immediately and transferring 6 existing roles to Saudi nationals to maintain current Nitaqat band standing.
Submit a Nitaqat exception request to the Ministry of Human Resources, detailing specialized technical requirements while maintaining current Saudi staffing levels.

M34.scenario: Talal Logistics, a Saudi‑owned freight forwarder, must fill a Supply Chain Coordinator role to manage inbound customs clearance for its new regional hub. The firm currently operates in a low Nitaqat band and is under pressure to increase its Saudi workforce to avoid penalties. Candidate A is a Saudi national with five years of experience in customs documentation, fluent in Arabic and English, but limited exposure to advanced Transportation Management System TMS modules. Candidate B is a non‑Saudi professional with eight years of experience, strong hands‑on expertise with TMS, and a lower salary request of SAR 8,500 compared with Candidate A's SAR 11,000.
M34.instructions: Which financial evaluation metric should you prioritize when comparing two capital expenditure proposals with different project lifespans?
choices: Calculate Net Present Value (NPV) using Equivalent Annual Annuity (EAA) or Equivalent Annual Cost (EAC) to compare annual financial value across different project durations.
Calculate Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for both proposals and select the option with the higher percentage return, assuming cash flows can be reinvested at the IRR.
Evaluate Payback Period for each proposal to identify which project recovers initial capital investment faster, prioritizing liquidity risk reduction.
Compute Profitability Index (PI) for both investment options, selecting the project with the highest ratio of present value to initial outlay.

M35.scenario: At Al-Majd Renewable Energy Company, a leading Saudi firm that designs and installs solar power systems, a senior project engineer with eight years of experience and consistently high performance ratings has been denied promotion to senior project manager. Instead, a junior engineer with three years of experience, who is the cousin of the company's chief operating officer, was selected based on a recommendation from the COO's office. The senior project engineer has submitted a formal grievance alleging that the promotion decision was influenced by wasta – personal relationships – and that the standard competency assessment and promotion criteria were not applied. Company policy requires that all promotions be advertised internally, evaluated against a transparent competency matrix, and approved by the HR Promotion Committee. The grievance includes performance appraisal scores, project delivery records, and a timeline showing that the junior engineer's promotion was announced before the required competency review was completed. As the HR Business Partner assigned to the case, you must address the employee's concerns while respecting cultural sensitivities and ensuring compliance with the organization’s promotion procedures.
M35.instructions: Which Cloud Infrastructure scaling strategy should you deploy to handle unpredictable web application traffic bursts efficiently?
choices: Deploy an Elastic Auto-Scaling group with predictive scaling policies, fronted by a load balancer with health checks and multi-zone deployment for high availability.
Configure horizontal pod autoscaling based on CPU and memory thresholds, setting static minimum instance counts to absorb initial traffic spikes.
Implement vertical scaling by automatically upgrading instance types during peak operational hours, scheduling scale-down windows during off-peak periods.
Deploy a serverless architecture with event-driven concurrency limits, managing database connection pools through dedicated proxy middleware.

M36.scenario: A senior front-end engineer at a logistics technology startup is guiding a newly hired developer through web fundamentals. The mentor asks the developer to choose the statement that accurately describes the browser's sequence of actions from the moment a user types the dashboard URL into the address bar and presses Enter until the interactive map UI is rendered.
M36.instructions: Which Cyber Security incident response step should you take immediately upon detecting unauthorized database access?
choices: Execute Containment protocol: isolate compromised network segments, revoke affected credential tokens, preserve system logs for forensics, and notify the Security Operations Team.
Initiate forensic log analysis to identify the attacker's IP address and entry vector, deferring credential revocation until evidence collection is complete.
Apply emergency security patches to database servers and restart application services, monitoring active user sessions for further unauthorized activity.
Isolate affected application servers and perform a full database restoration from the latest clean backup snapshot.

M37.scenario: A Saudi government agency is compiling a list of affordable housing units for a subsidy program. Each housing unit is represented by an object with fields such as unitId, location, pricePerMonth, and bedrooms. The operations team requires a reusable function that, given a maximum monthly rent, returns all units whose pricePerMonth is less than or equal to that threshold, preserving each unit as a complete object.
M37.instructions: Which state management pattern should you implement in React to prevent unnecessary component re-renders in a complex dashboard?
choices: Utilize selective state subscriptions with Zustand or Context + useMemo/useCallback, decoupling UI components and memoizing heavy computational sub-trees.
Move all component state to a centralized Redux store using global selectors, wrapping top-level components in React.memo HOCs.
Use React Component local state with custom event emitters to pass updates directly between sibling components, bypassing parent re-renders.
Implement React Query for server state caching and split local UI state into individual custom hooks per dashboard widget.

M38.instructions: Which Healthcare Data Governance framework should you enforce to ensure patient record privacy under Saudi health regulations?
choices: Implement Saudi Health Data Protection Law controls: enforce role-based encryption at rest and in transit, log all access trails, and establish data residency within KSA data centers.
Apply HIPAA privacy standards across electronic medical record systems, configuring automated audit logs for patient record access.
Implement data anonymization and pseudonymization protocols for secondary research databases, restricting patient identifier access to medical directors.
Configure patient consent management workflows and enforce multi-factor authentication for all clinical staff accessing remote health portals.

M39.scenario: You have been employed for 20 months as a senior GIS analyst at a renewable-energy consultancy that designs solar-farm projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. In this role you evaluate the technical feasibility of potential sites, liaise with client executives, and coordinate with equipment suppliers to align project timelines, deciding when to seek guidance from senior engineers.
M39.instructions: Which Supply Chain inventory control model should you select to minimize holding costs while preventing stockouts of critical spare parts?
choices: Implement an Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) model integrated with Safety Stock calculation based on lead-time variability and targeted service-level agreements.
Apply a Just-In-Time (JIT) replenishment strategy with key suppliers, reducing warehouse holding stock to minimal operational baselines.
Implement ABC Inventory Analysis, establishing daily cycle counts for Class A high-value components and periodic reviews for Class C items.
Configure a Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI) arrangement where component suppliers monitor warehouse stock levels and automate reorder triggers.

M40.scenario: A leading Saudi renewable energy firm is launching a new workforce development program for its Junior Marketing Analysts. To design targeted training and career pathways, the HR team needs a clear map of the essential duties and day‑to‑day tasks that define the role. Using the DACUM approach, you have been tasked with identifying the key duty areas and specific observable tasks performed by a Junior Marketing Analyst, and then critically evaluating whether your analysis captures all essential competencies, noting any gaps or assumptions.
M40.instructions: Which Talent Management strategy should you execute to address high turnover among specialized software engineering roles?
choices: Conduct stay interviews and market compensation reviews: establish clear technical career ladders, offer targeted professional development, and improve onboarding and culture feedback loops.
Increase base compensation and retention bonuses for critical engineering roles, while introducing mandatory exit interview reporting for HR.
Implement a structured mentorship program and expand internal training budgets, offering flexible remote work options to improve role satisfaction.
Revise recruitment criteria to select candidates with strong organizational tenure history, while streamlining quarterly performance appraisal cycles.

M41.scenario: You are a senior operations officer at a leading Saudi e-commerce logistics company. The business has just announced a strategic pivot to autonomous delivery drones to meet rising demand for rapid urban shipping. Your current responsibilities focus on warehouse coordination, a domain that will be largely replaced by drone fleet management. The rollout will begin in six months, and many of your peers are uncertain about the new technology and the implications for their roles. The leadership expects you to help design the transition plan and to upskill the team for the upcoming drone operations.
M41.instructions: Which DevOps CI/CD pipeline stage should you configure to catch security vulnerabilities before deploying to staging?
choices: Integrate Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Dependency Vulnerability Scanning into the automated build pipeline, failing builds on high/critical findings.
Configure Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) against automated staging deployments, generating vulnerability reports for development teams.
Implement container image vulnerability scanning during production deployment phases, alerting DevOps leads on unpatched base image packages.
Enforce mandatory manual peer code reviews and security checklist approvals before merging pull requests into the main repository branch.

M42.scenario: At Al-Majd Renewable Energy Solutions, the senior mechanical engineer, Khalid, and the senior project scheduler, Layla, have become increasingly tense over the decision to accelerate the prototype testing phase of a new solar inverter. Khalid argues that skipping certain validation steps will compromise the product's reliability, while Layla insists the client's tight deadline demands a faster release. Their disagreement has escalated into personal arguments during weekly meetings, causing delays in the team's workflow and lowering morale among the junior engineers.
M42.instructions: Which Legal and Regulatory Risk Management step should you prioritize when introducing an AI-driven credit scoring algorithm in Saudi Arabia?
choices: Ensure compliance with SAMA Consumer Protection and AI Ethics Guidelines: verify algorithmic explainability, audit for bias, obtain regulatory sandbox approval, and document model governance.
Conduct a comprehensive data privacy impact assessment under Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), establishing consent management workflows.
Implement model monitoring dashboards to track algorithmic drift and credit approval distribution across demographic segments.
Engage external legal counsel to review credit scoring disclosures and draft consumer terms of service regarding automated financial decisions.

M43.scenario: You are a senior nurse manager at a large tertiary hospital in Riyadh. The current patient discharge process is fully manual, taking an average of 45 minutes per patient and creating bottlenecks that reduce bed turnover and increase readmission risk. After a month‑long trial involving 30 patients, you have developed a prototype electronic discharge summary that integrates with the hospital's EMR and reduces the average discharge time to 20 minutes, saving roughly 25 minutes per discharge. The hospital discharges approximately 150 patients each day, six days a week, so the new system would free up more than 60 staff hours each week and is projected to lower readmission rates by 8%, resulting in an estimated annual cost avoidance of about SAR 2.5 million. You have been asked to present a concise three‑minute pitch at the upcoming quarterly executive meeting to obtain approval for a two‑week development sprint and the necessary training budget. In the pitch you need to clearly present the quantitative benefits, demonstrate your direct experience with the discharge workflow, and align the proposal with senior management's focus on improving patient flow, enhancing quality metrics and protecting revenue.
M43.instructions: Which Renewable Energy project risk mitigation approach should you take when solar farm construction encounters unexpected soil instability?
choices: Conduct a geotechnical re-assessment, evaluate pile foundation modifications with engineering leads, update project risk registers, and submit a formal variation request to the client.
Proceed with foundation installation using reinforced concrete ballast mounts, while conducting ongoing structural stability monitoring during construction.
Pause foundation installation on affected site sectors and negotiate an extension of time with the project employer under FIDIC contract terms.
Re-engineer mounting structure placements to avoid unstable soil zones, adjusting inverter layout plans to maintain generation capacity.

M44.scenario: A newly hired senior operations manager, Fatima, has joined Saudi Industrial Materials Co., a leading producer of steel components that recently transitioned to a digital factory model. Her first responsibility is to coordinate the launch of a new production scheduling system that will be rolled out across the company's multiple plants. The organization relies on a suite of cloud collaboration platforms: Azure Boards for agile task tracking, Teams for real‑time meetings and chat, SharePoint for document sharing, and a digital twin visualization tool hosted on the cloud. Fatima is technically proficient but has limited experience with this particular stack, and the rollout is scheduled to begin in ten days.
M44.instructions: Which Enterprise Architecture integration pattern should you select to connect legacy ERP software with a new cloud CRM?
choices: Deploy an Event-Driven Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) / API Gateway with asynchronous message queues, decoupling core ERP transactions from cloud CRM events.
Implement scheduled batch ETL pipelines to synchronize customer and transactional data between ERP and CRM databases during off-peak hours.
Build direct RESTful API integrations between ERP backend services and CRM webhooks, using mutual TLS authentication and error retry queues.
Deploy a change data capture (CDC) middleware solution to replicate database updates from ERP to CRM storage in near real-time.

M45.scenario: You are applying for a Junior Data Analyst position at a fast‑growing fintech company based in Jeddah. The company uses its internal talent marketplace to match candidates with project teams, and the application portal asks you to upload a concise professional profile summary that must not exceed 150 words, clearly describing who you are, the analytical projects you have completed, and the type of challenges you are eager to tackle. It also requires you to indicate your current Arabic and English language proficiency according to the CEFR framework, providing a brief justification for each level.
M45.instructions: Which Quality Management tool should you use to prioritize process improvement efforts when facing multiple customer complaint categories?
choices: Construct a Pareto Chart (80/20 rule) to identify the vital few complaint categories responsible for the majority of customer dissatisfaction.
Develop a Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagram to analyze root causes across People, Process, Technology, and Material factors for major complaint types.
Deploy a Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) matrix to score severity, occurrence, and detection risk for operational process steps.
Implement Value Stream Mapping (VSM) to analyze process flow inefficiencies and eliminate non-value-added activities across customer service.

M46.scenario: You are currently employed as a Junior Business Analyst at a leading Saudi fintech consultancy. In your upcoming bi‑annual performance review, your manager will request you to articulate a 3‑to‑5‑year career roadmap that demonstrates how you will expand your expertise, assume greater responsibilities, and contribute to the company’s vision of shaping the Kingdom’s digital economy.
M46.instructions: Which Strategic Product Management framework should you use to evaluate whether to build, buy, or partner for a new AI feature?
choices: Apply Core Competency and Strategic Value analysis: evaluate technical capability, time-to-market constraints, IP ownership, total cost of ownership, and long-term strategic advantage.
Conduct a detailed Net Present Value (NPV) and return on investment calculation for both internal development and third-party vendor licensing options.
Perform a competitive feature benchmark analysis, evaluating market adoption rates and implementation complexity across industry peers.
Execute a technical feasibility spike with internal engineering teams to estimate build effort before soliciting vendor partnership proposals.

M47.scenario: A Saudi project manager at a multinational oil‑and‑gas services company in Riyadh is leading a cross‑functional team that includes a senior technician from Brazil, who prefers indirect communication and values personal relationships, and a lead process engineer from Finland, who favors concise, data‑driven updates and strict adherence to schedule. During a safety‑critical design review, the Brazilian technician subtly signals concerns about a proposed valve configuration by mentioning past issues, while the Finnish engineer openly states that the current plan will miss the upcoming milestone. The manager must address both signals to keep the project on track and maintain team cohesion.
M47.instructions: Which Executive Stakeholder Management approach should you take when a major project milestone is delayed by 3 weeks?
choices: Brief executive sponsors immediately: present the facts, explain root causes, outline recovery options with cost/schedule trade-offs, and propose a revised baseline with a clear decision gate.
Issue a formal project status report updating milestone completion dates, while scheduling a dedicated briefing meeting with project sponsors.
Reallocate project resources and negotiate scope adjustments with team leads to recover 1 week of delay before escalating to executive leadership.
Present a revised project schedule during the monthly steering committee meeting, providing a detailed technical breakdown of contributing factors.

JOBFIT-ACCOUNTING-FINANCE-1.scenario: Saudi Green Energy Ltd., a solar power developer, has applied for a SAR 10 million term loan to finance the construction of a 50‑MW solar farm. The audited financial statements for the most recent fiscal year show a current ratio of 1.3, a quick ratio of 0.8, a debt‑to‑equity ratio of 1.6, an interest‑coverage ratio of 1.2 times, and a debt‑service‑coverage ratio of 1.1 times. Receivables represent 15 % of total assets, with 30 % of the receivable balance aged over 90 days. EBIT margin has remained stable at 7 % over the past three years, while operating cash flow has fallen from SAR 2.5 million to SAR 1.8 million. Management highlights strong demand for renewable energy but notes potential regulatory changes. The loan would be secured by the solar farm’s equipment and a partial pledge of the company’s existing land assets.
JOBFIT-ACCOUNTING-FINANCE-1.instructions: Analyze the credit risk using ratio analysis and the five Cs of credit, then write a detailed recommendation on whether to approve the loan, with any conditions or mitigations you deem necessary.
choices: Recommend decline or tightly conditioned approval: weak coverage (interest 1.2×, DSCR 1.1×), high leverage (D/E 1.6), weak liquidity (quick 0.8), aging receivables — require stronger equity/collateral, cash-flow covenants, and receivable cleanup before full SAR 10M.
Approve the full SAR 10M unsecured because renewable energy demand is strong, ignoring the weak coverage ratios.
Approve solely because land is pledged, without analyzing the five Cs or cash-flow adequacy.
Reject solely because the sector is renewable energy, without ratio analysis.

JOBFIT-ACCOUNTING-FINANCE-2.scenario: The university's Career Services Department reported a SAR 210,000 overspend for the latest quarter. Its approved budget was SAR 1,200,000, but actual expenditures rose to SAR 1,410,000. The variance is comprised of three elements: a 15% increase in the number of career‑development workshops delivered (driven by higher student participation), a 6% rise in the per‑workshop fee charged by external training providers, and a one‑off SAR 45,000 cost for relocating the spring job fair after the original venue was unexpectedly cancelled.
JOBFIT-ACCOUNTING-FINANCE-2.instructions: Which financial variance remediation approach should you take to address the SAR 45k budget overrun?
choices: Conduct a variance audit: categorize expenditure items into fixed and variable pools, reallocate contingency reserves with audit committee approval, and enforce project spend controls.
Reclassify the SAR 45k relocation cost as a capital expenditure asset to spread the variance across multi-year depreciation schedules.
Absorb the budget overrun into general administrative overhead accounts without adjusting project category baselines.
Defer vendor invoice processing to the subsequent fiscal quarter to align recorded expenses with quarterly budget allocations.

JOBFIT-ACCOUNTING-FINANCE-3.scenario: A fast-growing Saudi e-commerce startup has a three-person operations team. The team member responsible for order fulfillment also updates the inventory management system and prepares the month-end sales-inventory reconciliation that feeds into the company's SOCPA and CMA financial disclosures. During the latest quarterly audit, auditors identified that inventory levels were overstated while sales figures were understated, leading to an inaccurate financial statement. The discrepancy has raised concerns about the integrity of the disclosed financial data.
JOBFIT-ACCOUNTING-FINANCE-3.instructions: Analyze the situation described, identify the underlying segregation-of-duties weakness, explain how it creates fraud or error risk for the SOCPA/CMA disclosures, and suggest a practical, proportionate remediation suitable for a small team.
choices: Identify SoD failure (same person fulfills orders, updates inventory, and prepares sales-inventory reconciliation feeding SOCPA/CMA); risk of error/fraud and misstated inventory/sales; remediate with split duties or compensating reviews/system logs suitable for a 3-person team.
Conclude there is no control issue because the team is small and everyone must multitask.
Recommend firing the operations team without addressing segregation or compensating controls.
Fix only the latest numbers in the disclosure without changing process controls.

JOBFIT-HEALTHCARE-MEDICINE-1.scenario: In a bustling urgent care clinic, a 58-year-old man arrives with sudden left-side weakness, facial droop, and speech difficulty, indicating a possible stroke. At the same moment, the hospital's chief financial officer, a senior board member, presents for a routine skin lesion examination that can be safely postponed.
JOBFIT-HEALTHCARE-MEDICINE-1.instructions: Select the best action for the triage nurse.
choices: Activate the stroke protocol and treat the patient with facial droop first; then politely tell the CFO his skin lesion appointment will be delayed.
See the CFO first for his routine skin check, then assess the stroke patient.
Ask the CFO to wait in the waiting area while you complete paperwork for the stroke case.
Discharge the stroke patient to the waiting room so the board member is not inconvenienced.

JOBFIT-HEALTHCARE-MEDICINE-2.scenario: You are a data manager at the Saudi Center for Biomedical Research, which maintains a secured database of patient clinical trial records. A junior researcher in your team messages you on a personal instant‑messenger and asks you to copy a participant's complete electronic case report form (e‑CRF) onto a USB flash drive so they can analyze the data on their home laptop.
JOBFIT-HEALTHCARE-MEDICINE-2.instructions: Choose the best course of action to protect patient confidentiality and comply with data protection policies.
choices: Deny the request to use a personal USB drive and direct the researcher to access the e‑CRF through the institute�59s encrypted study portal, which logs all accesses.
Transfer the e‑CRF to the USB drive after encrypting the file and send it to the researcher.
Email the e‑CRF as a PDF attachment to the researcher�59s work address.
Upload the e‑CRF to a public cloud storage folder and share the link with the researcher.

JOBFIT-HEALTHCARE-MEDICINE-3.scenario: The outpatient medicine department at a regional hospital has recorded medication reconciliation errors in 28% of patient discharge summaries over the last three months. These errors have led to duplicate prescriptions and adverse drug events, prompting leadership to target a reduction in error rates by 50% within six months.
JOBFIT-HEALTHCARE-MEDICINE-3.instructions: Select the single most appropriate action to include in the Plan stage of the first PDSA cycle.
choices: Assign a dedicated pharmacist to review each discharge summary before finalization.
Conduct a one-time staff workshop on medication reconciliation best practices.
Develop a standardized electronic medication reconciliation checklist, train staff on its use, and collect baseline error-rate data before the first test.
Increase the number of discharge paperwork forms to allow more space for medication details.

JOBFIT-CYBERSECURITY-1.scenario: At 23:45, the SOC dashboard flagged a sudden surge of anomalous DNS queries from a critical payment‑processing application server, along with multiple failed SSH login attempts from an external IP. The server hosts transaction logs and is connected to the internal network, serving other services. Preliminary analysis suggests a possible compromise, but lateral movement has not yet been confirmed.
JOBFIT-CYBERSECURITY-1.instructions: Select the most appropriate first‑hour action to contain the breach while preserving evidence.
choices: Power off the compromised server immediately to stop the attack, then notify senior management.

Isolate the server from the network using a quarantine VLAN while preserving volatile memory and logs, then begin forensic data collection and notify the incident response lead for NCA‑aligned escalation.
Deploy an automated malware scanner across all hosts before confirming the source of the suspicious activity.
Send an immediate email to all users warning of a potential breach without first securing the affected system.

JOBFIT-CYBERSECURITY-2.scenario: Auditors for the Riyadh-based online marketplace AlMawaleh discovered that 30% of its customer-service representatives possess full read/write access to the production order database, while a single shared integration account is used by four automated order-processing pipelines. The shared account's credentials have not been rotated for 18 months, and the over-privileged user accounts exceed the permissions required for their daily tasks.
JOBFIT-CYBERSECURITY-2.instructions: Select the single most effective action to remediate the identified access-control issues.
choices: Implement a phased, business-aware rollout of RBAC roles, granting each role only the permissions required for its function and configuring automated secret rotation for the shared service account.
Strip all database write privileges from support staff without first assessing their job duties.
Keep the shared service account unchanged but enforce MFA for the engineers using it.
Schedule a manual password change for the service account next quarter and leave existing privilege assignments as is.

JOBFIT-CYBERSECURITY-3.scenario: A mid‑size Saudi construction firm has noticed that three project engineers received emails appearing to be from the procurement manager, containing a PDF attachment that, when opened, prompts the user to enter login credentials on a forged SharePoint site. The attachment also drops a backdoor onto the workstation. Within the next 24 hours, two additional engineers report similar messages, and one of them confirmed that their credentials were used to access the company’s project management system.
JOBFIT-CYBERSECURITY-3.instructions: Select the most comprehensive response that fully addresses the multi‑email phishing campaign and mitigates its impact.
choices: Search all mailboxes for matching phishing emails, list every recipient, extract indicators of compromise, block the malicious domain, reset compromised credentials, enforce MFA, and run a company‑wide awareness briefing.
Reset the passwords of the two engineers who opened the attachment and enable multi‑factor authentication for those accounts only.
Block the forged SharePoint domain and submit the incident report to the Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority.
Provide a phishing awareness workshop for the procurement and engineering teams, but leave the domain unblocked.

JOBFIT-HEALTH-MANAGEMENT-1.scenario: In the cardiac catheterization laboratory of a tertiary-care hospital, nursing staff have noted that after a procedure the single-use catheter trays are often placed uncovered on a nearby workbench while technicians retrieve other supplies. The uncovered trays remain on the bench for up to two hours during peak times, and the laboratory's storage cabinet is frequently full. No catheter-related bloodstream infections have been documented in the last month, but the practice creates a latent risk of microbial contamination that could lead to severe patient harm if an infected device is used.
JOBFIT-HEALTH-MANAGEMENT-1.instructions: Prioritise the most critical patient-safety risk in the scenario and propose a set of concrete, CBAHI-aligned controls to reduce its likelihood and severity.
choices: Prioritize contamination risk from uncovered single-use catheter trays left up to two hours; enforce immediate covered/sterile staging, clear bench policy, storage capacity fix, and monitoring aligned with CBAHI infection-prevention expectations.
Perform weekly bacteriological sampling of staging surfaces while maintaining current tray placement routines pending laboratory culture results.
Reallocate storage cabinet space from secondary supplies to accommodate catheter trays, deferring staff retraining on sterile staging protocols.
Implement a digital inventory tracking system for single-use devices to reduce workbench storage time while monitoring infection rates.

JOBFIT-HEALTH-MANAGEMENT-2.scenario: A leading e‑commerce retailer’s fulfillment center processes 30,000 orders per day. While inventory picking and sorting maintain a steady flow, the final packaging and label‑printing station has become a bottleneck, causing an average queue of 2,000 orders and shipping delays of up to 24 hours. The director wants to reduce the average order‑to‑shipment time to under 6 hours. Identify the downstream constraint, suggest a concrete flow change to relieve it, and propose a metric to confirm the improvement.
JOBFIT-HEALTH-MANAGEMENT-2.instructions: Explain how you would locate the constraint, design a specific flow change, and select a metric to evaluate the impact.
choices: Locate the constraint at final packaging/label-printing (2,000-order queue); change flow (extra pack station, parallel labeling, or WIP limit before pack); metric: average order-to-shipment time targeting <6 hours.
Speed up upstream picking further without changing the packaging bottleneck.
Measure only total daily orders with no time-to-ship metric.
Remove quality checks on packaging to go faster, with no constraint analysis.

JOBFIT-HEALTH-MANAGEMENT-3.scenario: You are a data protection officer at a large public hospital in Riyadh. A senior physician who leads a clinical research unit approaches you and says that a multinational pharmaceutical company has offered to fund a new study on the effectiveness of a novel diabetes medication.
